name: durable-streams
description: Effect-first Durable Streams protocol and memory host.

scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.test:conformance: bun run test:conformance:memory && bun run test:conformance:sqlite && bun run test:conformance:workerd && bun run test:conformance:remote && bun run --cwd packages/conformance-tests test:memory:wildcard
scripts.test:sql-dialects: bun run --cwd packages/storage test:dialects && bun run --cwd packages/projection test:dialects && bun run --cwd packages/serve test:dialects && bun run --cwd packages/conformance-tests test:pg && bun run --cwd packages/conformance-tests test:mysql
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/storage build && bun run --cwd packages/serve build && bun run --cwd packages/projection build
scripts.e2e:check: bun run --cwd e2e typecheck && bun run --cwd e2e test
scripts.test:e2e:deployed: bun run build && bun run --cwd e2e test:deployed
scripts.pack:dry-run: for dir in packages/core packages/storage packages/projection packages/serve; do (cd "$dir" && bun pm pack --dry-run) || exit; done
scripts.site:validate: env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site check:terms && env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site check:excerpts && env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site check:demos && env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site check:snippets && env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site check && env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site build && env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site check:og && env CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false bun run --cwd site check:links
